dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Ooh, this is quite snazzy. You've clearly done your research on venues to entertain guests in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Ahem... But naturally, I've seen it all before, so I'm a little harder to impress than most...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Do join me for afternoon tea. I'll have Mademoiselle Crabaletta serve us cakes.
